“An agreement, statement, or strongly worded social media post indicating a possible future interest in reducing hostilities, regardless of whether fighting actually stops.”
articles.body:
**SPRINGFIELD, MA — In what linguists are calling either “a practical modernization” or “the complete collapse of language itself,” Merriam-Webster announced Tuesday that it has officially updated the definition of the term *ceasefire* to mean:**


**“An agreement, statement, or strongly worded social media post indicating a possible future interest in reducing hostilities, regardless of whether fighting actually stops.”**


**The dictionary publisher insisted the move was not politically motivated, but rather an attempt to “keep pace with real-world usage.”**


**“For decades, people assumed a ceasefire involved the ceasing of fire,” explained Merriam-Webster senior editor Daniel Crumley during a press conference held beneath a projected image of several active war zones. “But recent geopolitical events have demonstrated that a ceasefire can also refer to continued missile strikes, drone attacks, retaliatory bombings, troop mobilizations, and increasingly hostile television interviews.”**


**The updated entry reportedly includes several example sentences, including:**

*  **“The ceasefire entered its third consecutive day of explosions.”**
* **“Both sides agreed to honor the ceasefire immediately after launching overnight strikes.”**
* **“Officials praised the symbolic ceasefire while civilians continued fleeing artillery fire.”**


**Critics blasted the move as Orwellian doublespeak designed to accommodate modern political messaging.**


**“This is like redefining vegetarian to include occasional ribs,” said Georgetown linguistics professor Marsha Bell. “Words are now being updated to fit press conferences rather than reality.”**


**Others applauded the decision as long overdue.**


**“Honestly this clears things up,” said one cable news analyst. “Previously viewers were confused when anchors announced a ceasefire while footage showed apartment buildings exploding in the background. Now the terminology finally matches the coverage.”**


**Truth Social hailed the change as “a tremendous victory for America, freedom, and frankly the English language itself,” adding that the old definition of *ceasefire* had been “very unfair and frankly outdated.”**


**In a celebratory post that received over 47,000 eagle emojis within hours, users praised the new wording for “giving words flexibility again.”**


**One prominent account wrote:**


**“Finally, dictionaries are no longer woke enough to insist things actually happen.”**


**The president himself reportedly weighed in shortly afterward, calling the update “a tremendous advancement for both peace and war simultaneously.”**


**Speaking to reporters during a meeting with the Joint Chiefs of Staff, he explained that the revised definition would finally make it possible to “hold a ceasefire while still bombing the country you’ve ceasefired with.”**


**“It’s a win for peace and for war at the same time,” the president declared. “It is peace through strength, strength through bombing, and now it’s officially in the dictionary.”**


**Administration officials praised the revision as “common sense modernization,” noting that previous definitions unfairly implied military operations had to actually stop during a ceasefire.**


**“That’s an old way of thinking,” one aide explained. “Today’s ceasefires are more nuanced. Sometimes the fighting pauses emotionally while continuing physically.”**


**During the same meeting, the president unveiled plans for what officials described as “the most aggressive peace initiative in modern military history.”**

![](/assets/img/a7ba3a80-acd6-4b49-b80d-87def4acc53f.png)


**Dubbed *Operation Ceasefire Eagle*, the proposal would reportedly involve the United States formally declaring an immediate ceasefire while simultaneously launching a military campaign designed to “return Iran technologically, industrially, and spiritually to the Stone Age.”**


**Standing beneath a giant projected copy of Webster’s updated definition, the president praised the dictionary revision for “finally giving our military the flexibility it deserves.”**


**“Under the old definition this operation would’ve sounded contradictory,” Trump explained while gesturing toward a PowerPoint slide reading *PEACE THROUGH STRENGTH THROUGH CONTINUED EXPLOSIONS*. “But thanks to Webster’s, America can now pursue peace and sustained aerial bombardment at exactly the same time.”**


**Pentagon officials described the operation as “kinetic diplomacy with de-escalatory branding.”**


**“The ceasefire component is rhetorical,” one senior defense official clarified. “The bombing component is operational.”**


**Military briefing slides shown to reporters reportedly included:**

*  **A bald eagle carrying an olive branch while fighter jets bombed targets in the background.**
* **A missile labeled *DIPLOMACY*.**
* **The slogan:**

**“YOU CAN’T SPELL CEASEFIRE WITHOUT FIRE.”**


**Administration officials repeatedly stressed that Operation Ceasefire Eagle represented “a modern ceasefire for a modern world.”**


**“This is no longer your grandfather’s ceasefire,” one spokesperson explained. “Today peace is proactive, muscular, and occasionally hypersonic.”**


**Truth Social users celebrated the announcement almost immediately, with hashtags including #BombingForPeace, #CeasefireEagle, and #PeaceThroughAirSuperiority trending within minutes.**


**One popular account posted:**


**“Finally a president brave enough to keep fighting during peace instead of waiting until after peace.”**


**Critics accused the administration of attempting to weaponize semantics itself.**


**“This is essentially warfare wearing a participation trophy labeled diplomacy,” said one foreign policy analyst. “We’re watching language become an active branch of the military.”**


**Sources inside the dictionary company say several additional revisions are now under consideration, including:**

*  **“Mission Accomplished” — A ceremonial banner displayed before complications begin.**
* **“Transparency” — The strategic release of information selected specifically to prevent transparency.**
* **“Temporary” — Potentially permanent depending on polling.**
* **“Fact Check” — A politically immersive creative writing exercise.**
* **“Humanitarian Strike” — An explosion delivered with deep concern.**
* **“De-escalation” — Increasing military activity with calmer phrasing.**


**The announcement immediately sparked debate online, where supporters described the update as “nuanced,” while critics accused Webster’s of “trying to gaslight the English language.”**


**At press time, Webster’s confirmed it was also reviewing whether the word *“imminent”* should continue implying something is actually about to happen.**
articles.author: Connie Lingus
articles.title: Webster’s Updates Definition of “Ceasefire” to Reflect Modern Usage

articles.excerpt: In what administration insiders initially described as “the biggest diplomatic breakthrough of the decade,” members of the Trump negotiating team reportedly erupted into celebration late Wednesday night after Iranian officials appeared open to discussions involving “settlement,” “transition,” and most importantly, “regime change.”
articles.body:
WASHINGTON — In what administration insiders initially described as “the biggest diplomatic breakthrough of the decade,” members of the Trump negotiating team reportedly erupted into celebration late Wednesday night after Iranian officials appeared open to discussions involving “settlement,” “transition,” and most importantly, “regime change.”

According to sources close to the talks, several members of the U.S. delegation became visibly emotional upon hearing the phrase repeated multiple times by Iranian representatives.

“The Iranian people want it. Their leadership wants it. Frankly, the whole world wants regime change,” one senior Trump advisor reportedly said while uncorking a bottle of Diet Coke and chanting “USA” in a secure conference room.

![](/assets/img/happy.png)

President Trump himself immediately took to Truth Social just minutes after the meeting concluded.

“MASSIVE BREAKTHROUGH WITH IRAN. REGIME CHANGE IS IMMINENT!!! MANY PEOPLE ARE SAYING THIS SHOULD HAVE HAPPENED YEARS AGO!!!”

Markets briefly surged overnight amid rumors that Tehran was preparing for a historic political transition.

The celebration reportedly came to an abrupt halt, however, after a late-night phone call from Jared Kushner clarified a critical translation issue.

According to sources, the Iranian officials were not discussing regime change in Iran.

They were discussing regime change in America.

Witnesses say the room fell silent for nearly twenty seconds before one aide quietly asked whether that technically still counted as “progress.”

![](/assets/img/despon.png)

The president did not immediately comment publicly after the clarification, though aides say he quickly began reframing the misunderstanding as “a possible strategic opening.”

“Look, a regime change somewhere is still movement,” one administration official explained Wednesday morning. “You can work with movement. Momentum matters.”

Iranian officials later attempted to clarify their remarks during a press conference in Geneva.

“We simply expressed our belief that the current American administration may eventually be replaced through elections,” one diplomat stated carefully. “This is normally how democracy functions.”

The clarification reportedly triggered another round of confusion among several cable news commentators, one of whom briefly described elections themselves as “a concerning escalation.”

Meanwhile, Truth Social users continued celebrating the original announcement well into Wednesday afternoon, with many insisting the president had “forced Iran to negotiate with itself.”

At press time, administration insiders confirmed the White House was still considering whether the misunderstanding could somehow be turned into “a win.”
articles.author: Gabby Pentin
articles.title: Trump Team Celebrates “Regime Change” Breakthrough Before Discovering It Was About America

articles.excerpt: In what officials are calling “the most aggressively American sporting event in modern history,” President Donald Trump announced Thursday that Robert F. Kennedy Jr. will wrestle a live 40-foot python on the White House lawn immediately prior to next month’s UFC championship card.
articles.body:
WASHINGTON, D.C. — In what officials are calling “the most aggressively American sporting event in modern history,” President Donald Trump announced Thursday that Robert F. Kennedy Jr. will wrestle a live 40-foot python on the White House lawn immediately prior to next month’s UFC championship card.

The spectacle, described by administration insiders as “Fear Factor meets the Roman Empire,” is expected to draw tens of thousands of spectators, several cable news helicopters, and at least three emergency antivenom teams.

![](/assets/img/snakelawn.png)

Kennedy — currently serving as head of the CDC, longtime environmental lawyer, and what the White House referred to as an “avowed herpetologist and alpha outdoorsman” — will reportedly enter the arena shirtless wearing only blue jeans, cowboy boots, and what insiders describe as “a medically questionable amount of confidence.”

“This isn’t just snake wrestling,” Kennedy told reporters while aggressively slapping a coil of climbing rope against his thigh. “This is about restoring America’s connection to apex reptiles.”

According to sources close to the administration, Kennedy has spent months preparing for the bout at a private training facility somewhere in rural Florida. His preparation reportedly included wrestling live boa constrictors, underwater breath-holding exercises, and handling “industrial quantities of cooked spaghetti” to improve hand speed and snake-grappling reflexes.

“A lot of people think spaghetti training is a joke,” Kennedy explained. “But when you’ve got forty feet of angry python wrapped around your torso, finger dexterity becomes life or death.”

![](/assets/img/spahetti.png)

A leaked CDC training memo also suggested Kennedy has increased his testosterone regimen ahead of the event while experimenting with several “cutting-edge peptide compounds,” one of which allegedly “may significantly enhance finger speed.”

Medical experts contacted for comment universally responded with prolonged silence.

White House physicians reportedly attempted to intervene before ultimately concluding that “nobody here technically has the authority to stop this.”

President Trump, speaking from the Rose Garden beside a giant promotional poster reading *SNAKEFEST: FREEDOM STRANGLEHOLD*, praised Kennedy’s courage.

“Bobby’s a natural snake guy,” Trump said. “People don’t know this, but he’s tremendous with reptiles. Maybe the best ever. The snake actually requested him. True story.”

The president added that the python — nicknamed *Liberty Fang* by administration officials — was “very strong, very respected in the reptile community.”

Sources inside the UFC organization say organizers were initially hesitant about the idea until internal polling showed the python wrestling segment tested “exceptionally well” with undecided voters and men who own tactical sunglasses.

The event is expected to feature full military flyovers, monster trucks, and a ceremonial bald eagle release, although insiders admit several agencies remain unclear on which part of the government is technically authorizing any of this.

Meanwhile, critics have raised concerns about safety, legality, and whether the CDC director should be engaged in hand-to-hand combat with a giant constrictor moments before a professional cage-fighting event.

Those concerns were dismissed Thursday by Kennedy himself.

“People said man shouldn’t fight snakes,” he said while wrapping athletic tape around both forearms. “Those same people also said raw milk was dangerous.”

At press time, betting markets briefly crashed after rumors spread that Kennedy planned to attempt a rear naked choke on the python.
articles.author: Gloria Holle
articles.title: White House Announces RFK Jr. Will Wrestle 40-Foot Python Before UFC Event on South Lawn “America Has Forgotten the Ancient Bond Between Man and Snake,” Says Kennedy

articles.excerpt: Riding high after Webster’s controversial new definition of the word “ceasefire,” President Donald Trump announced Thursday that his administration would officially adopt what he called a bold new governing philosophy: “Strength Through Weakness.”
articles.body:
WASHINGTON, D.C. — Riding high after Webster’s controversial new definition of the word “ceasefire,” President Donald Trump announced Thursday that his administration would officially adopt what he called a bold new governing philosophy: **“Strength Through Weakness.”**

The doctrine, according to White House officials, seeks to establish American global dominance by systematically weakening nearly every traditional source of American power.

“In the old days people thought strength came from alliances, stability, economic power, functioning institutions,” Trump said from a hastily assembled Rose Garden press conference. “Wrong. Totally wrong. Weak is strong now. Losing is winning. Frankly nobody understands weakness better than me.”

Observers noted the president appeared energized throughout the announcement, repeatedly pointing toward a large easel displaying the phrases:

**LOSING = WINNING**

**WEAKNESS = STRENGTH**

**CHAOS = LEADERSHIP**

The sign reportedly appeared to have been designed in Microsoft Word using at least three unrelated fonts.

As reported this week in *The Public Record News*, Webster’s newly modernized definition of “ceasefire” — now understood as “an agreement that may or may not result in the actual ending of fighting but conveys the appearance of wanting to end the fighting” — appears to have heavily influenced the administration’s new strategic worldview.

White House aides reportedly circulated the article internally earlier this week, with one senior adviser calling it “the intellectual backbone of second-term foreign policy.”

According to administration officials, the “Strength Through Weakness” initiative has already been quietly underway for years.

“It started with pulling out of treaties worldwide,” Trump explained. “You weaken alliances, isolate yourself diplomatically, and suddenly everyone underestimates you. Tremendous negotiating position.”

Officials later clarified this was merely “Phase One.”

“Then came tariffs specifically designed to weaken the dollar and destabilize global trade relationships,” explained one aide. “Traditional economists called it damaging. But under the new framework, economic instability is itself a form of leverage.”

Trump also pointed to recent tensions with Iran as evidence the strategy is succeeding.

“People said we got outsmarted by a third-rate country,” Trump said. “Exactly. That proves how weak we became. And because weakness is strength, that means we’re stronger than ever.”

Domestically, the president highlighted efforts to weaken long-standing democratic institutions and public trust as essential components of the plan.

“Weaken the institutions. Weaken trust. Weaken alliances. Weaken expertise,” Trump declared. “Eventually nobody knows what’s happening anymore. That’s when America becomes unstoppable.”

The president reportedly described the resulting political confusion as “a very advanced form of patriotism.”

MAGA support for the initiative was swift and immediate.

![](/assets/img/supporter.png)

“That’s why we voted for him!” shouted Florida resident and self-described patriot Dale Branscomb while wearing a sleeveless American flag hoodie outside a Buc-ee’s. “Anybody can make America strong through strength. That’s easy. But it takes a real genius to make America strong through obvious institutional decline.”

Another supporter praised Trump for “thinking outside the box of basic geopolitical reality.”

“He’s playing fourth-dimensional weakness chess,” said one attendee. “The more unstable things become, the more stable we actually are. The media just doesn’t understand advanced patriotism.”

Several supporters admitted they were initially confused by the doctrine before realizing “confusion itself was part of the strategy.”

Following the event, Truth Social briefly crashed after users flooded the platform with slogans including:

“If America collapses hard enough, we win automatically.”

and

“Our weakness has never been stronger.”

At press time, administration officials confirmed the White House was exploring renaming the Department of Defense to the **Department of Strategic Vulnerability**, while a new national slogan was reportedly under consideration:

**“America: Proudly Declining Since 2025.”**

The proposed campaign logo reportedly features a bald eagle struggling to carry a cinder block.

For additional context on the administration’s apparent intellectual inspiration, see this week’s *Public Record* report on Webster’s revised ceasefire definition:
 The Public Record – “Webster’s Updates Definition of ‘Ceasefire’ to Reflect Modern Usage”
articles.author: Tammy Flue
articles.title: Trump Unveils New Doctrine: “Strength Through Weakness”

articles.excerpt: In what critics are calling “either the logical endpoint of modern politics or the greatest misunderstanding of biology in recorded history,” New York State lawmakers on Tuesday passed sweeping legislation expanding abortion rights to include dependent adults up to the age of 30.
articles.body:
**ALBANY, NY — In what critics are calling “either the logical endpoint of modern politics or the greatest misunderstanding of biology in recorded history,” New York State lawmakers on Tuesday passed sweeping legislation expanding abortion rights to include dependent adults up to the age of 30.**


**The measure, officially titled the *Extended Maternal Choice and Basement Dweller Viability Act*, allows parents to seek what lawmakers describe as “retroactive reproductive intervention” for adult children deemed “non-viable contributors to society.”**


**Supporters of the bill cited a growing population of what state officials labeled “failure-to-launch offspring” — adults residing indefinitely in childhood bedrooms and basements while surviving primarily on video games, energy drinks, sports betting apps, marijuana cartridges, and loosely defined cryptocurrency ventures.**


**“These are technically adults,” said State Assemblywoman Denise Harrow during debate on the bill, “but many have never evolved beyond microwave pizza rolls and Discord arguments. Science has to acknowledge reality.”**


**Under the legislation, state review boards may classify individuals as “pre-independent” if they meet at least four qualifying conditions, including:**

*  **owning more gaming headsets than dress shirts,**
* **referring to podcast hosts as “father figures,”**
* **believing opening a Robinhood account constitutes a career,**
* **or beginning every sentence with “Bro, hear me out.”**


**Proponents hailed the move as a landmark declaration that women remain in control of their bodies — even decades after giving birth.**


**“My son is 27 years old,” said one Long Island mother who testified before lawmakers. “He still asks me to cut the crust off his sandwiches and calls DoorDash ‘a side hustle.’ At some point this becomes a public health matter.”**


**Governor Kathy Hochul defended the law at a press conference Tuesday afternoon, insisting critics were deliberately mischaracterizing the legislation.**


**“No one is talking about harming adults,” Hochul clarified. “This bill simply creates compassionate end-of-life pathways for men who still use the phrase ‘grindset alpha.’”**


**The law’s first reported implementation allegedly occurred Wednesday morning in Poughkeepsie, where a local couple announced they had finally “removed” their 30-year-old son from the family basement after what they described as “years of non-viability.”**

![](/assets/img/firstguy.png)


**“It was time,” said the father while standing beside several unopened boxes of adjustable dumbbells and rubber gym flooring. “Truthfully we needed the room for a home gym, and he was down there live-streaming himself ranking breakfast cereals for seven hours a day.”**


**The mother appeared emotional but resolute.**


**“We loved him,” she explained. “But eventually you have to ask yourself if a man who refers to Mountain Dew Code Red as ‘fuel’ is ever really going to leave.”**


**According to neighbors, the adult son had not held full-time employment since briefly driving for DoorDash in 2021, though he frequently described himself online as “an entrepreneur in stealth mode.”**


**Opponents immediately condemned the measure as unconstitutional, biologically impossible, and “probably illegal under several Geneva Conventions.”**


**Yet the legislation has also created unusual political alliances in states normally hostile to abortion rights.**


**“I don’t support abortion for unborn babies,” said one conservative caller on a Syracuse radio program. “But once the kid is 29, unemployed, and still screaming at strangers on Xbox at 3 a.m.? Game on.”**

![]()


**Florida Governor Ron DeSantis responded within hours by announcing plans for a competing “Stand Your Basement” initiative designed to protect unemployed adult sons from “government overreach and forced responsibility.”**

![](/assets/img/desantis.png)


**Meanwhile, several young men interviewed outside a Buffalo GameStop expressed concern the law unfairly targeted vulnerable communities.**


**“This is literally genocide against gamers,” said 29-year-old Kyle Bender while vaping near a lifted Subaru. “Just because I live with my mom doesn’t mean I’m not building something. I’m currently launching a streaming brand.”**

![](/assets/img/gamestop.png)


**Another protester insisted lawmakers were ignoring the economic realities facing young men today.**


**“You try affording rent while also buying collector’s editions and maintaining a proper GPU setup,” said one demonstrator carrying a sign reading *STOP THE 30-YEAR ABORTION LOOPHOLE.***


**At press time, New York lawmakers were reportedly considering follow-up legislation allowing tax deductions for parents forced to listen to aspiring podcasters record motivational content from behind soundproof foam panels.**
articles.author: Connie Lingus
articles.title: New York Legalizes “Postpartum Abortions” for Adults Up to Age 30

articles.excerpt: In what sociologists are calling “the inevitable collapse of civilized greeting rituals,” a bizarre new social phenomenon known as hello humping has exploded across the United States after going viral on Instagram and TikTok earlier this spring.
articles.body:
**LOS ANGELES — In what sociologists are calling “the inevitable collapse of civilized greeting rituals,” a bizarre new social phenomenon known as *hello humping* has exploded across the United States after going viral on Instagram and TikTok earlier this spring.**


**The trend, which began as a joke among college-aged partygoers, involves enthusiastically dry-humping the leg of friends, acquaintances, coworkers, and occasionally complete strangers as a form of greeting, affection, or social dominance.**


**Experts say the behavior appears loosely modeled after dogs greeting one another at public dog parks.**


**“At first we thought it was isolated ironic behavior,” said cultural anthropologist Dr. Melissa Crane. “But now we’re seeing organized hello-humping circles at tailgates, rooftop bars, music festivals, and apparently three different accounting firms in Phoenix.”**


**The practice reportedly started after several viral videos showed groups of young men greeting each other at parties by sprinting across rooms and aggressively attaching themselves to one another’s legs while screaming things like “BROTHER!” and “ALPHA ENERGY.”**


**Shockingly, the behavior has spread far beyond Gen Z.**


**“The first time it happened to me I was honestly stunned,” said Brooklyn resident Lauren Feldman, 28. “I nearly fell over when my friend Sadie suddenly started dry-humping my leg at a birthday party. But honestly? It’s kind of intimate. Way warmer than a handshake.”**


**Professional sports have also begun embracing the trend.**

![](/assets/img/footballer.png)


**During recent NBA and NFL celebrations, athletes were seen briefly mounting teammates after big plays, while several hockey players reportedly attempted dominance humping against opposing team members during pregame warmups.**


**“It establishes psychological control,” explained one anonymous linebacker. “You can’t fully focus on coverage assignments after another grown man has greeted you like a golden retriever.”**


**The craze officially entered mainstream celebrity culture this week after Prince Harry posted a now-viral Instagram reel showing himself enthusiastically humping the leg of actor Ben Affleck at a Hollywood charity event.**


**Witnesses say Affleck appeared “confused but emotionally resigned.”**

![](/assets/img/princeharry.png)


**Social media reaction has been mixed.**


**Critics describe the trend as “society in terminal decline,” while supporters insist hello humping promotes emotional vulnerability, physical closeness, and “a return to mammalian authenticity.”**


**Several startups have already moved to capitalize on the craze, including a new dating app called *Humpd*, as well as luxury denim companies marketing “reinforced greeting zones” around the thigh area.**


**Meanwhile, HR departments nationwide are reportedly in absolute crisis.**


**“We genuinely do not know how to write policy language for this,” admitted one Fortune 500 executive. “Legally speaking, there’s a massive difference between sexual harassment and whatever these people insist is ‘friendly dominance acknowledgment.’”**


**The trend has since evolved into increasingly elaborate forms of what online communities are now calling “dog maxxing” — a lifestyle movement encouraging participants to embrace what supporters describe as “peak canine social energy.”**


**Practitioners have begun incorporating behaviors once thought exclusive to household pets, including excited jumping, playful baying, celebratory sniffing rituals, and in some extreme cases “rear wagging,” in which participants aggressively wiggle their hips upon encountering close friends or romantic partners.**


**“It’s honestly made social interactions more pure,” said 24-year-old influencer Cody Marks while wearing a shirt reading *LET DOGS BE DOGS*. “Humans spent too long pretending we’re above instinct. Sometimes when my boys arrive at the bar I just feel compelled to bark once or twice and lightly circle them.”**


**Videos tagged #DogMaxxing have now surpassed 2.3 billion views online, with tutorials teaching followers how to properly establish “pack hierarchy” at parties through posture, eye contact, and controlled greeting humps.**

![](/assets/img/dogmaxxing.png)


**Some adherents have gone further still, greeting loved ones by excitedly sprinting toward them while vocalizing what experts describe as “happy husky noises.”**


**Psychologists remain divided.**


**“This may represent a deep longing for uncomplicated social connection in an increasingly isolated digital society,” explained behavioral therapist Dana Kell. “Or civilization may simply be ending. It’s honestly too early to tell.”**


**Airports have reportedly become one of the movement’s largest hotspots, with multiple viral clips showing returning travelers collapsing emotionally into exaggerated dog-like greeting behavior near baggage claim.**


**Meanwhile, several gyms nationwide have banned “territorial dominance humping” after repeated incidents involving squat racks and pre-workout supplements.**


**At press time, PetSmart had reportedly asked several participants to stop attempting to socialize with actual golden retrievers “as peers.”**
articles.author: Dirk E. Sanchez
articles.title: “Hello Humping” Sweeps the Nation as Americans Abandon Handshakes Entirely

articles.excerpt: A TED Talk attended by nearly 500 people was abruptly evacuated Saturday after audience members were reportedly exposed to what emergency officials are calling a “sustained vocal fry and upspeak event” during a keynote presentation by billionaire influencer and entrepreneur Claire Foundry.
articles.body:
**SAN FRANCISCO — A TED Talk attended by nearly 500 people was abruptly evacuated Saturday after audience members were reportedly exposed to what emergency officials are calling a “sustained vocal fry and upspeak event” during a keynote presentation by billionaire influencer and entrepreneur Claire Foundry.**


**Foundry was midway through her presentation, *“Disrupting Authenticity: How To Manifest Your Inner Tech Brah,”* when witnesses say her speech patterns began to deteriorate.**


**“It started gradually,” said attendee Jason Mendelson. “A little fry here, a little upspeak there. We thought maybe she was nervous. Then she hit us with three consecutive ‘literallys’ in vocal fry and every sentence became a question?”**

![](/assets/img/speaker.png)


**Within minutes, audience members began reporting symptoms including vertigo, nausea, ringing ears, confusion, and an overwhelming desire to leave the building.**


**“It was like being trapped inside an Instagram motivational reel,” said another attendee. “Every sentence sounded like a question and every word sounded like it was being dragged across gravel.”**


**According to eyewitnesses, the situation worsened when several audience members politely asked Foundry to stop.**


**Emergency responders believe this may have triggered a feedback loop that caused the vocal fry to intensify.**


**“The more people reacted, the stronger it became,” explained one firefighter. “By the end she was producing levels of vocal fry we previously believed were only achievable by reality television personalities and lifestyle podcasters.”**


**Panic quickly spread through the auditorium.**


**Video from the scene shows audience members covering their ears, crawling beneath seats, and desperately searching for emergency exits while Foundry continued speaking about personal branding, disruption, and monetizing authenticity.**

![](/assets/img/aftermath.png)


**Three attendees were transported by ambulance to a nearby hospital where they were listed in stable condition but described by medical personnel as “extremely shaken.”**


**One victim reportedly continues to experience flashbacks whenever someone begins a sentence with the phrase, “So basically…”**


**Doctors say recovery may take weeks.**


**Officials from TED issued a statement expressing concern for those affected while emphasizing that vocal fry incidents remain extremely rare.**


**“TED remains committed to spreading ideas worth sharing,” the statement read. “However, future events may include designated Vocal Fry Safety Officers, emergency ear protection stations, and a strict limit on the number of consecutive upspeaks permitted per presentation.”**


**Foundry later apologized on social media.**


**“I just want everyone to know that like, literally? My intention was always authenticity?” she wrote in a statement that experts say may have inadvertently triggered several additional cases.**


**At press time, federal regulators were reportedly considering new warning labels for public speaking events, while the Department of Homeland Security raised the national Vocal Fry Threat Level from ‘Elevated’ to ‘Concerning.’**


***If you or someone you love has been affected by vocal fry or chronic upspeak exposure, help is available. Call the National Vocal Fry Assistance Hotline at 1-800-NO-LIKE-UH. Trained counselors are standing by to reassure callers that not every sentence needs to end like a question?***


***Warning signs may include excessive use of the words “literally,” “authenticity,” “curated,” and “journey.” Do not attempt to confront severe vocal fry alone. If exposure lasts longer than four hours, seek immediate medical attention or listen to Morgan Freeman narrate literally anything.***
articles.author: Ram Itinn
articles.title: TED Talk Evacuated After Audience Subjected to Catastrophic Vocal Fry Incident

articles.excerpt: Historians, linguists, and several exhausted telecommunications providers confirmed Tuesday that two friends have officially surpassed 100,000 pages of text messages in what is believed to be the longest-running argument in human history regarding whether America is the greatest country in the world.
articles.body:
**INTERNET — Historians, linguists, and several exhausted telecommunications providers confirmed Tuesday that two friends have officially surpassed 100,000 pages of text messages in what is believed to be the longest-running argument in human history regarding whether America is the greatest country in the world.**

**The dispute began innocently enough when Juan Lopez, fresh out of Manila and fresh off a Trump rally, texted longtime friend Stan from Ohio, “America is obviously the greatest country ever created.”**

**What followed was a communications event of such magnitude that several AI systems reportedly requested hazard pay to analyze it.**

**Juan maintained that America was unparalleled in every conceivable category.**

**“Best economy. Best military. Best freedom. Best hamburgers. Best parking lots. Best gas stations. Best everything,” Juan reportedly texted sometime during the first 10,000 pages.**

**Stan, meanwhile, adopted what experts described as the fatal “nuanced position.”**

**“Some things are great,” Stan responded. “Other countries do healthcare better. Some have lower crime. We could probably improve a few things.”**

**That statement alone generated another 14,000 pages of argument.**

**The two men argued continuously through presidential elections, pandemics, economic cycles, three phone upgrades, six broken charging cables, and the complete collapse of several group chats unfortunate enough to contain them.**

![](/assets/img/subway.png)

**At one point the conversation became so large that neither participant could remember what they were originally arguing about.**

**“It doesn’t matter anymore,” said Juan. “America is still number one.”**

**“I never said it wasn’t good,” replied Stan. “I said it’s complicated.”**

**Sources say neither man has ever changed his position by even a fraction of a degree.**

**The achievement has drawn comparisons to legendary feats of endurance.**

**“They’re like texting alpinists climbing Mount Everest without oxygen,” said one observer. “Except instead of summiting, they just keep reaching another false peak and discovering a new argument about life expectancy in Denmark.”**

**Friends report that both participants occasionally disappear for sleep before immediately resuming the argument upon waking.**

**“Good morning,” one would text.**

**“America invented mornings,” the other would reply.**

**Researchers studying the exchange estimate that if printed, the conversation would stretch from New York to Chicago and still contain at least 4,000 unread messages debating whether high-speed rail is communist.**

**As of press time, the argument had entered page 100,247 after Stan made the mistake of mentioning that perhaps other countries have better public transportation.**

**Juan was reportedly typing.**
articles.author: Gloria Holle
articles.title: Two Friends Reach 100,000 Chat Pages in Endless Argument Over Whether America Is the Greatest Country in the World

articles.excerpt: As a rapidly growing Ebola outbreak continues to spread across parts of Central Africa, Health and Human Services Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. unveiled what administration officials are calling a “paradigm-shifting bio-optimization response package” consisting of 1,600 handcrafted cedar saunas and one million doses of high-performance peptides.
articles.body:
**WASHINGTON, D.C. — As a rapidly growing Ebola outbreak continues to spread across parts of Central Africa, Health and Human Services Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. unveiled what administration officials are calling a “paradigm-shifting bio-optimization response package” consisting of 1,600 handcrafted cedar saunas and one million doses of high-performance peptides.**


**Speaking at a packed press conference Thursday, Kennedy outlined his plan while standing in front of a giant banner reading “HEAT SHOCK PROTEINS: NATURE’S VACCINE.”**


**“Traditional public health keeps asking about vaccines, antiviral treatments, containment strategies, and basic infectious disease management,” Kennedy explained. “But what if instead we increased heat shock proteins through aggressive sauna exposure?”**

![](/assets/img/saunas.png)


**According to Kennedy, patients exposed to temperatures approaching those of a midsummer Arizona parking lot could theoretically encourage the body’s natural healing processes.**


**“When your body gets hot enough,” he explained, “all kinds of things happen. Science calls these heat shock proteins. I don’t fully understand them, but they sound incredible.”**


**The first shipment includes 1,600 luxury cedar saunas, many featuring Bluetooth speakers, chromotherapy lighting, integrated cold-plunge recovery tubs, and premium Scandinavian cedar sourced from sustainable forests.**


**Administration officials estimate the units will begin arriving in affected villages sometime between six and eighteen months from now.**


**The second phase of the initiative involves distributing one million doses of performance-enhancing peptides.**

![](/assets/img/peptides.png)


**“The peptides will help rebuild muscle tissue, maintain vitality, improve recovery, and keep testosterone levels where they belong,” Kennedy said. “You may have Ebola, but at least you’ll be shredded.”**


**Reporters repeatedly asked whether the administration planned to support vaccine development or approved antiviral therapies currently being researched for the outbreak.**


**Kennedy appeared unconvinced.**


**“We have to be careful,” he said. “Whenever someone says ‘vaccine,’ I start asking questions.”**


**When pressed further about whether Ebola and autism were related in any way whatsoever, Kennedy paused for several seconds before replying, “I’m just saying nobody’s looked closely enough.”**


**Several public health experts attending the briefing appeared visibly confused.**


**One epidemiologist was seen lowering his head into his hands while another quietly Googled whether resignation letters could be submitted electronically.**


**The World Health Organization, which has been coordinating emergency response efforts, declined to comment directly on the sauna initiative, issuing only a brief statement that read:**


**“Please stop.”**


**The plan quickly won praise from podcast host Joe Rogan, who dedicated nearly three hours of his show to discussing what he called “the untapped potential of heat shock proteins.”**


**“I’ve been talking about this forever,” Rogan said. “People keep bringing up things like virology and epidemiology, but have they tried kettlebell swings in a cedar sauna? That’s the real question.”**

![](/assets/img/rogan.png)


**Rogan noted that he had largely defeated COVID through a combination of exercise, supplements, and discussing elk meat with guests for extended periods of time.**


**“If we can get enough people doing burpees in a sauna, who knows what’s possible.”**


**The popular podcaster immediately offered to travel to Africa as part of the administration’s response team.**


**Joining him would reportedly be podcaster Lex Fridman and endurance athlete Cam Hanes, who would assist local communities with what officials described as “Ebola-gauged functional fitness programming.”**


**Under the proposal, patients would participate in a carefully structured recovery protocol consisting of sauna sessions, kettlebell circuits, hill sprints, archery practice, deadlifts, cold plunges, and lengthy discussions about personal responsibility.**


**Fridman reportedly volunteered to spend up to six consecutive hours asking the virus philosophical questions.**


**“If Ebola and humanity can simply understand each other better,” Fridman explained, “perhaps both sides can grow from the experience.”**


**Meanwhile, Hanes pledged to run continuously between affected villages while carrying a weighted pack and occasionally shouting, “KEEP HAMMERING!”**


**Administration officials described the trio as “perhaps the most physically optimized infectious disease task force ever assembled.”**


**Several epidemiologists were later observed quietly updating their résumés.**


**Meanwhile, administration officials confirmed that a follow-up shipment of grass-fed beef liver supplements, artisanal spring water, testosterone-optimization literature, and a collection of motivational podcasts is currently being assembled for deployment later this summer.**


**When asked about potential drawbacks of installing thousands of cedar saunas across regions already experiencing temperatures above 100 degrees, Kennedy remained undeterred.**


**“That’s actually part of the strategy,” he explained. “People keep focusing on the heat, but they’re forgetting about the heat shock proteins.”**


**Several reporters attempted to point out that Ebola patients frequently suffer from severe dehydration and other life-threatening complications.**


**“Exactly,” Kennedy replied. “And what better way to test the body’s resilience than placing it in a handcrafted cedar recovery environment?”**


**Asked whether any clinical evidence supported the plan, Kennedy pointed toward a chart labeled “HEAT SHOCK PROTEINS?” featuring several upward-pointing arrows and a drawing of a muscular stick figure.**


**“The science is still evolving,” he said. “But if heat shock proteins can survive in a sauna, why couldn’t they survive Ebola?”**


**Administration officials later clarified that the chart had been created with crayons during the flight to the press conference.**


**At press time, Kennedy was reportedly exploring whether a combination of cold plunges, elk meat, intermittent fasting, grounding mats, sunlight exposure, positive thinking, and tactical breathing exercises could be used to combat malaria.**


**Sources inside the department confirmed that a pilot program involving cryotherapy chambers, barefoot walking, organic raw milk, and Brazilian jiu-jitsu instruction was already under consideration for future pandemic preparedness efforts.**
articles.author: Ana L'fissure
articles.title: RFK Jr. Announces Bold Ebola Response: 1,600 Cedar Saunas and One Million Performance Peptides Headed to Africa

articles.excerpt: What was expected to be a routine scientific execution turned into one of the most shocking nights in modern academic history last Thursday when Flat Earth enthusiast P.D. Gurnheim appeared to defeat renowned MIT astrophysicist Dr. Gary Gayax in a debate that has left the scientific community reeling.
articles.body:
**CAMBRIDGE, MA — What was expected to be a routine scientific execution turned into one of the most shocking nights in modern academic history last Thursday when Flat Earth enthusiast P.D. Gurnheim appeared to defeat renowned MIT astrophysicist Dr. Gary Gayax in a debate that has left the scientific community reeling.**


**The debate, held before a packed auditorium at MIT, was originally promoted as an educational event demonstrating how science dismantles common misconceptions.**


**Most attendees arrived expecting Gurnheim to be thoroughly humiliated.**


**For the first hour, those expectations seemed well founded.**

![](/assets/img/roundone.png)


**Dr. Gayax methodically dismantled every major Flat Earth argument. Satellite imagery was presented. Telescope observations were reviewed. Mathematical proofs were displayed. Gravity, orbital mechanics, and centuries of astronomical observation were explained in painstaking detail.**


**Meanwhile, Gurnheim struggled to defend claims involving a giant ice wall surrounding the planet, a celestial firmament, and his assertion that stars were actually “God’s flashlights.”**


**By intermission, audience polls showed support for Round Earth exceeding 90 percent.**


**“It was an absolute massacre,” said MIT graduate student Trevor Hanley. “The Flat Earth guy was getting obliterated.”**


**Then came Round Two.**


**As the debate resumed, Gurnheim walked calmly toward a large window overlooking the campus. Outside, a bright full moon hung in the evening sky.**


**Without saying a word, he extended his arm.**


**Then he raised his thumb.**


**The moon disappeared behind it.**


**The auditorium fell silent.**


**Several attendees reportedly gasped.**


**One professor dropped a notebook.**


**Another was heard whispering, “Dear God.”**


**After a long pause, Gurnheim turned toward the audience.**


**“Can everyone see that?” he asked.**


**The crowd nodded.**


**“My thumb is smaller than the moon,” he continued. “Yet my thumb covers the moon.”**


**Witnesses report that Dr. Gayax stared motionless for nearly twenty seconds.**


**According to multiple attendees, the astrophysicist eventually responded:**


**“I…had not considered that.”**


**The room erupted.**

![](/assets/img/thumbsup.png)


**Audience members immediately began performing their own experiments. Some covered the moon with thumbs. Others used quarters, fingers, and coffee cups.**


**One engineering student reportedly ran from the building screaming, “Everything is perspective!”**


**Another reportedly replied, “What even is perspective?”**


**Within hours, social media was flooded with photographs of people covering celestial bodies with their thumbs.**


**The fallout was immediate.**


**Several prominent astrophysicists weighed in over the following days, including Neil deGrasse Tyson, who addressed the controversy during a podcast appearance.**


**“Look,” Tyson reportedly said. “I tried it myself. You absolutely can cover the moon with your thumb. That’s just a fact.”**


**Tyson then stared thoughtfully at his hands for several moments before adding:**


**“I don’t know where this leaves us.”**

![](/assets/img/tyson.png)


**Artists and photographers quickly responded by suggesting that the phenomenon might simply be explained by perspective and the fact that nearby objects can appear larger than distant ones.**


**Flat Earth supporters dismissed the explanation immediately.**


**“Interesting that ‘perspective’ suddenly becomes important the moment science gets challenged,” said one supporter online.**


**As debate raged worldwide, MIT officials announced a stunning development.**


**Beginning this fall, the university will establish a new Department of Flat Earth Studies to investigate the implications of Gurnheim’s discovery.**


**According to preliminary course offerings, students will be able to enroll in:**

*  **Introduction to Thumb-Based Astronomy**
* **Advanced Firmament Engineering**
* **Ice Wall Infrastructure and Maintenance**
* **Perspective: Coincidence or Cover-Up?**
* **The Moon: Smaller Than Previously Estimated**
* **Comparative Thumb Sciences**


**Gurnheim has reportedly been offered a visiting professorship and will serve as chair of the department’s newly established Center for Celestial Thumb Research.**


**Standing outside the newly designated Hall of Flat Earth Studies, Gurnheim remained humble.**


**“I never set out to change science,” he said. “I just asked people to look at the moon.”**


**At press time, researchers at Harvard had entered crisis mode after discovering that a quarter held at arm’s length can completely cover Jupiter, while Princeton physicists announced emergency funding for a project tentatively titled *‘Why Does This Keep Happening?’***
articles.author: Di Angleberry
articles.title: Flat Earther Stuns MIT, Launches New Academic Department After Revolutionary Moon Discovery

articles.excerpt: Beauty retailer Ulta Beauty announced a groundbreaking new partnership Thursday with social media influencer Clavicular, whose controversial facial "bone remodeling" videos have amassed billions of views and several strongly worded statements from medical professionals.
articles.body:
BOLINGBROOK, IL — Beauty retailer Ulta Beauty announced a groundbreaking new partnership Thursday with social media influencer **Clavicular**, whose controversial facial "bone remodeling" videos have amassed billions of views and several strongly worded statements from medical professionals.

Beginning this summer, Ulta stores nationwide will carry the new **Clavicular Facial Remodeling System™**, a do-it-yourself facial enhancement kit promising consumers "the jawline they deserve" through what promotional materials describe as "precision-guided micro-fracture technology."

![](/assets/img/clavicover.png)

Retailing for $99.99, the starter package includes a carbon-fiber tapping wand, contour calipers, an ice pack, motivational affirmations, and access to an online video course entitled *Manifesting Your Skull's True Potential.*

According to company representatives, the system also comes with an advanced AI-powered facial mapping application that scans users' faces and generates a personalized remodeling blueprint.

"The AI can show teenagers exactly how they'll look after completing their remodeling journey," said Clavicular during a livestream viewed by nearly three million followers. "For years we've been trapped by the facial structure nature gave us. Technology finally allows us to become who our cheekbones were always meant to be."

The app reportedly offers customization options including "Nordic Warrior," "Luxury Villain," "Mysterious European Soccer Player," and the increasingly popular "Looks Good in Airport Selfies" package.

Medical experts were quick to express concern.

"We strongly advise against intentionally fracturing your face with tools purchased next to mascara and bath bombs," said Dr. Elaine Hartwell of the American Association of Maxillofacial Surgeons. "This is not how bones work. This is not how medicine works. Frankly, this is not how anything works."

Nevertheless, demand appears strong among younger consumers.

![](/assets/img/liningup.png)

"I've already remodeled my chin twice," said 16-year-old Tyler Benson while comparing AI-generated projections on his phone. "The first one only got me to an 8.4. This next remodel should push me into the low nines."

Ulta executives remain optimistic.

"We've always believed beauty should be accessible," said one company spokesperson. "Whether that's skincare, cosmetics, or controlled skeletal restructuring, our mission remains the same."

The company confirmed that premium subscription members will receive monthly updates as beauty standards evolve online.

At press time, Clavicular had announced plans for an expanded product line including DIY clavicle lengthening kits, orbital socket contouring guides, and a luxury "BoneMaxx Platinum" package featuring titanium tapping implements and priority access to AI-generated attractiveness forecasts.

Shares of several helmet manufacturers rose sharply following the announcement.
articles.author: Gloria Holle
articles.title: Ulta Announces Partnership With Influencer Clavicular to Launch DIY Facial Remodeling Kits

articles.excerpt: In what company executives are calling “a long overdue update to modern dating,” Tinder announced Tuesday the launch of its revolutionary new Catfish Button, allowing users to instantly transform nearly every aspect of their profile with a single tap.
articles.body:
**LOS ANGELES, CA — In what company executives are calling “a long overdue update to modern dating,” Tinder announced Tuesday the launch of its revolutionary new Catfish Button, allowing users to instantly transform nearly every aspect of their profile with a single tap.**


**The new feature, located prominently next to the profile photo upload section, can automatically enhance facial features, add six inches of height, generate a more exciting career, improve hobbies, adjust political views, change age, and, for premium subscribers, even switch genders entirely.**


**“We spent years trying to eliminate catfishing,” said Tinder spokesperson Ashley Monroe. “Eventually we realized we were fighting human nature. The overwhelming majority of our users were already presenting highly fictionalized versions of themselves. We decided to streamline the process.”**


**Upon pressing the button, users are presented with several options including:**

*  **Light Catfish — Remove wrinkles, add jawline, claim to enjoy hiking.**
* **Moderate Catfish — Become a successful entrepreneur with a rescue dog and a beach house.**
* **Advanced Catfish — Gain a six-pack, doctorate degree, yacht ownership, and fluency in Italian.**
* **Nuclear Catfish — Entirely new face, personality, age, gender, and life history.**

  ![](/assets/img/6d2727ac-3c23-4ba2-8f89-8871d66cf112.png)


**Perhaps most controversially, Tinder has also introduced a “I Prefer the Catfish” setting, allowing users to indicate they would rather date the fictional version of a person than the real one.**


**“Honestly, the fake version was way more interesting,” said one beta tester after meeting a date who turned out to be a 43-year-old accountant instead of the 28-year-old professional surfer-neurosurgeon depicted in his profile. “The catfish had ambitions. The real guy collected commemorative spoons.”**

![](/assets/img/eb7e2d4b-025a-45fa-a587-e86f767c0c95.png)


**Early reactions have been overwhelmingly positive.**


**“Everyone catfished at least a little before,” said Tinder user Megan R., whose profile currently depicts her as a 31-year-old yoga instructor living on a vineyard in Tuscany. “Now it’s baked into the app. It just makes everything more efficient.”**


**Industry analysts believe the feature could dramatically reduce disappointment during first dates because expectations will already be set at “complete fiction.”**


**Competitor dating apps are reportedly rushing to develop similar tools. Bumble is testing an “Imaginary Personality Generator,” while Hinge is beta-testing a feature that automatically replaces every photo with professionally lit images taken during the user’s single best hair day.**


**Not everyone is convinced.**


**Critics argue the feature could further blur the line between reality and fantasy. Tinder executives disagree.**


**“That line disappeared sometime around 2017,” Monroe said. “We’re simply acknowledging it.”**


**At press time, Tinder announced plans for a future update that will allow users to catfish themselves so thoroughly that they begin believing their own profile.**
articles.author: Unida Blumkin
articles.title: Tinder Embraces Reality of Online Dating, Launches New “Catfish Button”

articles.excerpt: Mattress giant Serta has announced what industry analysts are calling the biggest innovation in sleep technology since memory foam: a brand-new mattress specifically engineered for the growing soak community.
articles.body:
**SALT LAKE CITY, UT** — Mattress giant Serta has announced what industry analysts are calling the biggest innovation in sleep technology since memory foam: a brand-new mattress specifically engineered for the growing soak community.

Dubbed **“The Middle Man,”** the mattress seeks to solve one of soaking’s oldest logistical challenges: *How can a couple soak when there’s nobody around to jump on the bed?*

“People have been asking this question for years,” said a Serta spokesperson during a packed product unveiling Thursday. “We looked at the problem and asked ourselves, ‘What if the bed could be the middle man?’”

The answer is a mattress loaded with cutting-edge sensors, artificial intelligence, and vibration technology inspired by the coin-operated vibrating motel beds of the 1970s.

Once users activate **Soak Mode™**, the mattress automatically begins a carefully calibrated rocking motion designed to simulate the presence of an enthusiastic third-party bed shaker.

According to company literature, customers can choose from several settings, including:

* **Slow & Steady**
* **Gentle Fellowship**
* **Youth Group Retreat**
* **Rock My World™** (currently the most popular setting)
* **Mission Trip Turbo**

  ![](/assets/img/639feae8-468b-4717-8924-a645bab165b0.png)

The mattress also features Wi-Fi connectivity, smartphone controls, over-the-air updates, and integration with major smart home systems.

“Imagine saying, ‘Alexa, activate Rock My World,’” said one engineer. “We’re living in the future.”

Retailing for **$1,999.99**, the Middle Man will debut at select Sleepy’s locations throughout Salt Lake City before rolling out nationwide later this year.

![](/assets/img/831b69ac-2945-4304-9705-457ee05a6dd4.png)

Initial reactions from the Mormon community have reportedly been overwhelmingly positive.

“I hate to sin and I love to soak,” said local resident Tanner Whitmore. “But finding a third person willing to spend two hours jumping on the bed was always so daunting. This really streamlines the entire experience.”

Another early tester praised the convenience.

“Before, coordinating schedules was impossible,” he explained. “Now the mattress handles everything. Technology is amazing.”

Not everyone is celebrating the innovation.

Several church elders have publicly decried the Middle Man mattress, warning that the technology could become a slippery slope toward what one called “fully automated temptation.”

“We have serious concerns about where this could lead,” said Elder Jacob Henderson during a recent community forum. “Today it’s a vibrating mattress. Tomorrow it’s who knows what.”

Despite the public criticism, signs of enthusiasm remain difficult to ignore.

One church elder, speaking on the condition of anonymity, admitted he had already placed a preorder.

“I feel strongly that this product is wrong,” he said while nervously checking his order status. “That being said, my estimated delivery date is next Tuesday between 10 a.m. and 2 p.m.”

Serta executives declined to comment on the apparent contradiction, noting only that preorders from Utah had exceeded all expectations.

Industry experts predict strong demand among consumers seeking what Serta calls a **“hands-free soaking solution.”**

At press time, Tempur-Pedic was reportedly scrambling to develop a competing product tentatively named **The Holy Roller™**, while Sleep Number announced plans for a premium model that automatically adjusts firmness based on the level of guilt experienced by users.

Meanwhile, Serta announced that all first-generation Middle Man mattresses would include a complimentary one-year subscription to **SoakSync+**, allowing users to download new vibration patterns, share custom settings with friends, and receive firmware updates designed to keep pace with the rapidly evolving soaking industry.

Shares of several mattress manufacturers rose sharply following the announcement as investors bet that automated soaking technology could become the fastest-growing segment of the bedding market.

“We’re not just selling a mattress,” said one Serta executive. “We’re selling innovation.”

He then reportedly winked before being escorted away from the microphone by company attorneys.
